contract.rendering: project(grid)-anchor*scale; rotate around scaled canvas centre; ascending drawOrder; ground first
contract.collisions: Nominal ground footprint convex polygon against full building/Lv0 slots, rotated path canvas, bridge and river cells; canopy pixels may overhang. Props may overlap each other. Ground-decal textures have zero occupancy and may underlay reserved cells; they are not physical props.
contract.runtime: Only instances are terrain draw data. reviewOnly is never drawn by the game loader. Existing game buildings own reserved slots.
contract.approval: Approved original art; strict exclusion changes require new visual review; no runtime/gameplay claim.
contract.texture: 512px native texture plane, repeating every 8 grid units; clip to zone rectangles
